children: Indian IT services firm LTM (LTM.NS), formerly known as LTIMindtree, reported a marginal fall in second-quarter profit on Friday.
Consolidated profit for the fell about 0.2% to 13.98 billion rupees ($147.22 million) in the quarter ended September 30, from 14.01 billion rupees a year earlier.
Revenue from operations in the quarter rose 13.6% year-on-year to 118.08 billion rupees.
